title: Verbal nouns
summary: Use `-mAk` as a noun, with case endings (*Ýüzmegi gowy görýärin*, *okamaga başladym*, *ýüzmekden gorkýar*) and possessive endings (*Meniň gitmegim gerek*, *Onuň gelmegini isleýärin*); make nouns with `-(Y)ş` and `-(Y)w` (*giriş, çykyş, okuw*); and say why with `-mAgA` and `-mAk üçin` (*Okamaga geldim*).
canDo: Talk about what you like, want and are trying to do
Say who needs to do something and what you want someone else to do
Understand everyday nouns made from verbs, such as entrance, exit and studies
Say why you go somewhere or do something
